fetched_pages.title: Field query object
Introduction
fetched_pages.content:
Welcome to Sensible! To get started, see the following endpoints for extracting structured data from documents.

Endpoints:
- Document extraction (asynchronous): Extract doc at a Sensible URL, Extract doc at your URL. Takes a document file, such as a PDF, and returns extracted data asynchronously. Use the asynchronous endpoints in production.
- Document extraction (synchronous): Extract data from a document. Returns extracted document data synchronously. Use this endpoint for testing.
- Get Excel from PDFs: Get Excel extraction. Get well-structured Excel files converted from PDF documents.
- Portfolio extraction (asynchronous): Extract portfolio at a Sensible URL, Extract portfolio at your URL. Use these endpoints with multiple documents packaged into one PDF file.
- Document type classification: Classify document by type.

fetched_pages.title: SenseML reference introduction
fetched_pages.content:
Overview of the SenseML query language

Use the SenseML query language to extract structured data from documents, for example, auto insurance quotes, home inspection reports, or your custom documents.

SenseML topics include: Field query object, Preprocessors, LLM-based methods, layout-based methods, Configuration settings, Computed Field methods, Sections, Conditional execution, Large spreadsheet extraction, Postprocessor.

A config specifies how to extract data and how to populate a target output schema.

Example config extracts: _driver_name_raw (layout-based, using anchor 'name of driver' + label method below), policy_period and policy_number (LLM-based, queryGroup method), driver_name_last (computed field splitting the raw name).

Key elements: Fields (queries that extract text), Preprocessors (e.g. pageRange to cut irrelevant pages), Fingerprints (tell Sensible which config to use), Computed fields (transform already-extracted data).
